data.title: naapperas.pt
data.summary: This website: Astro 7 on Cloudflare Workers, with EmDash on D1 and R2 and the admin behind Cloudflare Access.

children.text: My personal website, rebuilt in 2026. Pages are rendered by Astro 7 on Cloudflare Workers and cached at the edge, so most visits never reach the Worker.
Content lives in EmDash, an Astro-native CMS backed by D1 and R2. Publishing a change purges only the affected pages from the cache. The admin sits behind Cloudflare Access.

data.title: naapperas.pt
data.summary: Este site: Astro 7 em Cloudflare Workers, com EmDash sobre D1 e R2 e a administração protegida por Cloudflare Access.

children.text: O meu site pessoal, refeito em 2026. As páginas são geradas pelo Astro 7 em Cloudflare Workers e guardadas em cache na edge, por isso a maioria das visitas nunca chega ao Worker.
O conteúdo vive no EmDash, um CMS nativo de Astro que usa D1 e R2. Publicar uma alteração limpa da cache apenas as páginas afetadas. A administração está protegida por Cloudflare Access.

data.title: zon
data.summary: zod's expressive validation, brought to Python with an API that stays close to the original.

children.text: zon gives Python the expressive and powerful validation logic of zod, combined with the flexibility of Python. I started it to solve a quick need in a college project.
The public APIs of the two libraries differ in places, but zon tries to stay as faithful as possible to the design decisions made by zod.

$media.alt: Screenshot of the SDLE shopping list app

data.title: SDLE
data.summary: Local-first shopping lists you can share. They sync when you're online and keep working when you're not.

children.text: SDLE (Smart Distributed List Engine) is a shopping list editor for creating and sharing lists with friends and family.

The SvelteKit web app periodically syncs with a backend server whenever there is a connection. Without one, it keeps working offline: every change is persisted locally and synced as soon as you're back online.
The backend uses CRDT-like data structures and gossip protocols to stay highly distributed and eventually consistent.

$media.alt: Screenshot of the SDLE shopping list app

data.title: SDLE
data.summary: Listas de compras local-first e partilháveis. Sincronizam quando há rede e continuam a funcionar quando não há.

children.text: O SDLE (Smart Distributed List Engine) é um editor de listas de compras para criar e partilhar listas com amigos e família.

A aplicação web, feita em SvelteKit, sincroniza periodicamente com um servidor sempre que há ligação. Sem ligação, continua a funcionar offline: todas as alterações ficam guardadas localmente e são sincronizadas assim que voltar a estar online.
O backend usa estruturas de dados do tipo CRDT e protocolos gossip para ser altamente distribuído e eventualmente consistente.

data.title: LUIS
data.summary: League of Legends Universe Indexing and Search: a search engine for everything in the League of Legends universe.

children.text: LUIS (League of Legends Universe Indexing and Search) is a search engine for all things related to the League of Legends universe. It features champion highlights, their stories and much more.
A scraping pipeline fetches pages from the League of Legends Universe website and indexes them in Apache Solr, with a SvelteKit front end on top.
